title: Denver Equestrians Riding School
specs: Programs suitable for all ages and skill levels.
Must complete DERS Introductory Lesson before enrolling in private/group lessons.
To enroll in Li'l Equestrians (ages 5-7) and Beginner camp levels, assessment lesson required.
Semi-private lessons allow up to 3 riders (siblings/friends/family).
Group lessons have 4 or more riders of the same ability.
Parents/guardians/family are welcome on 'Horse Show Day' of camps.

blurb: Denver Equestrians Riding School offers private, semi-private, and group lessons for children and adults of all abilities, as well as seasonal horse camps and special youth or adult programs. The school provides instruction using their own 'happy, healthy school horses' at a 32,000 sq. ft. equestrian center.
